message:
fix(apk): the decoder's codec has a thread of its own -- receive, control and the UI never wait for a slow codec (keepalive-r2 e, Codex apk-decoder-liveness r1)

ke-r23 (the AVD, relay): after a selection the sharpening path timed out, the surface was swapped
and the codec re-made -- 6 s on that loaded emulator -- under the sink's one lock. The receive
thread, which also carries the UDP control channel, and the session's control thread call into
that same lock: control ACKs stopped, the host's retransmits ran out (24 x 250 ms) and the
session ended peer-lost before a first frame.

The sink (android_video_decoder.cpp) now owns its codec on ONE worker thread -- the old output
pump. Every AMediaCodec_* call and every window release happens there, with the state lock
released (CodecCall). The state lock (gate, binding, counts, epochs, a bounded frame inbox) is
never held across a codec call, a wait or a join:
- RX: owner, selection gate, into the inbox (8 frames / 4 MB; the oldest goes -- a lost IDR is
  owed again and asked for, the deltas after the gap wait for the next IDR); returns.
- control hooks and UI queries: the short lock only; no codec pump on the caller's thread.
- surface / binding / selection / stream reset / discontinuity: change the state at once and ask
  the worker for a codec reset (codecResetSeq_). A codec made, fed or shown while a reset was
  pending is void: never used, never fed, never marks a newer selection ready.
- the UI's detach (SetSurface(null)) still returns only once the codec let go of the surface
  (MainActivity DetachDecoder needs it) -- the UI waits, RX and control do not (Codex D1 (a)).
- the IDR debt is paid only by a real queueInputBuffer of an unchanged generation, as before.
- video_debug: codecState / codecFail / codecVoid / inbox / inboxDrops / gapDrops / resetPending.
The SH test seam's delay (test builds only) also runs with the lock released.

Tests (Windows, the product sink against the stand-in NDK; fake_ndk can now HOLD create /
configure / start / stop without its lock, and counts threads, deletes, windows):
- android_decoder_liveness_test 35/35 x5: create held 8 s while RX 30 fps / control every 20 ms /
  UI every 50 ms -- every call < 50 ms (max 0 ms); inbox <= 8; first input after the hold an IDR
  on the right surface; no caller thread touched the codec; surface replaced / detach / owner
  change / newer selection / saturation / create failure / teardown under the hold.
- android_decoder_session_liveness_test 9/9 x5: the PRODUCT VideoReceiveMain + both UDP control
  channels (product timings) over loopback with a fake host; create held 8 s: control both ways
  never silent > 252 ms, no peer-lost on either end, first input after it an IDR.
- NEGATIVE: the 9f9a91c sink -- liveness 19 FAIL (RX / control / UI held 12 s), session 4 FAIL
  (control silent 8 s, the HOST declares peer-lost: ke-r23's shape). Mutant m1 (no generation
  check on a codec result) 3 FAIL; m2 (unbounded inbox) 3 FAIL.
- the older sink tests read the logic after the worker settled (SettledSink, WaitIdleForTest --
  REMOTE60_DECODER_TEST_HOOKS, test targets only): binding 17/17, owed key 32/32, geometry,
  decode stats -- each x5.
APK: assembleDebug / assembleRelease / assembleDebug -Pgnlink.shTestSeam=true, 4 ABIs, build OK;
the release .so carry the new code and no WaitIdleForTest. Not run on a device yet.
